limits: A linguistic screen of every entry is not a fresh dictionary lookup for every entry.
Automated membership, coverage and grading checks do not certify semantics.

No claim of zero remaining errors, exhaustive lemma knowledge, exact top-1500 rank or 90-percent coverage.
